name: garmin
description: Garmin Connect health and fitness data from your agent, for Claude Code and Codex - Body Battery, HRV, resting heart rate, stress, sleep stages and score, activities, VO2 max, training load, training status and training readiness. Answers a question live, or writes a day as a markdown snapshot and a week as a rollup you can keep. Your credentials stay on your machine and the data goes nowhere but Garmin and you.
